notes: Registration creates a DRAFT organisation. Retry fingerprint is peppered; no token response is cached.
Returns tokens OR a short lived single use MFA challenge. Generic credential errors; account/client rate limits.
Rotates once. Reuse invalidates the entire token family, including access tokens. A concurrent loser triggers family revocation.
Requires the current password; when MFA is configured, recent step-up is required. Revokes all sessions.

kind defaults to TOTP; EMAIL uses the account email, SMS requires phone in E.164 form. TOTP returns its seed only during enrolment; EMAIL/SMS queue an encrypted Notification challenge and return no secret or code. Confirm possession before activation; only one method may be pending/active per account.
Single confirmation returns eight one-time recovery codes; store securely. Other sessions are revoked.
With mfa_token completes login and returns Tokens; without it requires account authentication and returns {verified:true}. Recovery=true accepts one unused recovery code; TOTP replay is rejected.

Authenticated EMAIL/SMS step-up challenge, bound to this live session; five-minute expiry and five attempts. TOTP uses its authenticator app. Idempotent retries replay the original queue acceptance, not delivery; expired challenges require a new key.
Recent MFA plus password; removes method and revokes all sessions.
Revokes all sessions associated with this account-owned device; client labels never establish trust.
Validates a live membership and changes only this session. Use returned access token. The signed Gateway organisation must match the account token.

Token from secure Notification delivery is single use and expires. Existing active accounts must authenticate as the invited account. New provisional accounts set a password; no credentials are reset for existing accounts.
Explicit Annex D.1 compatibility alias of GET /organisation; identical handler and security.
Explicit Annex D.1 compatibility alias of PATCH /organisation; identical versioning, validation and security.
Explicit Annex D.2/Annex E projection alias of GET /organisation/verification. Section 4 authority workflows are not exposed.
Annex D.1 effective operating-capacity projection. Unsupported, unverified, expired and restricted capacities cannot authorize.
Current version required. Registered identity fields are editable only in DRAFT; later changes require an authoritative review.
Uses stable organisation-scoped provider idempotency and authenticated current-status lookup; no automatic approval.
Existing authenticated reverify contract; stable key from previous case. Preserves immutable linkage history and restricts operations pending renewed authoritative approval.
503 until a capacity-specific authenticated provider assertion adapter is available. Generic KYB does not establish capacity eligibility.
Primary representative only. Resume requires current KYB and exact independent approval; closure of a previously active business requires downstream readiness contracts.
503 until the Verification provider supports legal representative assertions. Requires active successor and exact independent approval; does not grant successor permissions.

Notification Service delivers a protected token; raw token never returned. After first activation, exact independent STAFF_ROLE_CHANGE approval is required. During initial onboarding only the representative may configure privileges with MFA.
Evidence references only. Successor must already have scope authority; departing staff lose access immediately. No permission is transferred by handover.
Only the designated active successor can acknowledge.
An administrator other than departing staff completes the acknowledged handover. Final termination uses PATCH staff; completed evidence is immutable.

Normal termination requires completed acknowledged handover; immediate suspension remains available. Role/scope expansion needs exact independent approval after activation; self escalation forbidden. Suspension/termination immediately revoke sessions selected into this organisation.
Creates explicit versioned capability mapping. Exact independent STAFF_ROLE_CHANGE approval required after activation; role name never authorizes.
Creates next immutable role version. Existing memberships retain their current version until an approved reassignment.
Creates immutable next policy version. Existing approval requests keep their original policy snapshot.
Binds canonical operation digest and immutable policy version; amounts are integer minor units with currency. Drafts must be submitted before decisions.

Also requires current-level approver capability, scope and amount limit. Ordered independent approvers; no self approval or one actor across independent levels. Atomic row lock and version protect concurrency.
Only delegator/delegate membership grants are listed.

Scoped read, hierarchy-write and explicit approval capabilities, at most 30 days. Approval decisions retain delegator provenance and cannot approve a delegator request or reuse one authority across independent requirements. Must fit direct authority and recipient role ceiling. Chaining prohibited; source revocation is checked on every use.
Lists the authenticated member’s grants; independent reviewers use the audited grant reference.

Designated senior role; 20-character reason; branch/department/team only; hierarchy:read or staff:read; 30–900 seconds. Exact independent BREAK_GLASS_ACCESS approval after activation; every use audited; explicit denies and tenant boundaries remain enforced.
Independent reviewer only; immutable once completed; revokes access immediately.

Exact independent INVENTORY_RESTRUCTURE approval, source and destination scope, snapshot versions and dependency safety. Approval operation is {node_id,command:<body without approval_id>}. Never-active draft subtrees need no external dependency assertion; prior-active structures fail closed without a complete current assertion.

Activation requires current KYB, supported verified capacity and applicable property authority. Destructive prior-active transitions require exact approval and dependency assertions. Draft archival preserves canonical IDs; cascade must be explicit.

Typed MEMBERSHIP or ASSOCIATES only; CONTAINS changes use move. Independent approval binds the exact node/command; group membership never replaces a physical parent. Optional previous_parent_id + previous_parent_version atomically transfers a collection membership; both portfolio scopes and subtree revisions are required.

Provider+object_type+external_id is tenant-unique. Remapping requires expected_node_id, mapping version, node_version/tree_version and previous_node_version/previous_tree_version plus exact INVENTORY_MAPPING_CHANGE approval, both resource scopes and applicable dependency assertions.
Authenticated owning Verification case read-back. Property/parcel subject and domain must match. create_case uses a stable provider key; stale projection cannot authorize a newer structural version.
Authenticated Media metadata and explicit owner validation. Stores references/status only, no bytes. Supported purposes PHOTO, DOCUMENT, SURVEY, FLOOR_PLAN, DIGITAL_TWIN, WARRANTY.
Fresh metadata read plus owning Media purpose-bound HTTPS URL; no URL or document bytes are stored; audited, no-store response.
Operator-confirmed coordinates reference existing same-property canonical space IDs and a fresh READY floor-plan/digital-twin media link. No 3D generation or competing property graph.

One MiB bounded structured JSON/CSV, maximum 1000 rows. No external URL/file fetching. Async preview does not mutate inventory; stable source keys, typed dependencies and exact provider IDs determine identity.
